subtitle.en: A VISUAL BENCHMARK FOR THE LONMA LINEUP

lede.zh: 从车身比例、轮毂姿态到底盘高度，记录一台街道项目车的完整视觉方向。
lede.en: Body proportions, wheel fitment, and ride height establish one complete direction for a street-focused build.

story.zh: 这台车的调整从整体轮廓开始。每一次修改都经过观察、试装与道路使用，再保留真正适合车辆的部分。
story.en: The process began with the car's overall silhouette. Each change was evaluated, test-fitted, and road-tested before becoming part of the final build.

description.en: LONMA DYNAMIC Case 01 STREET WIDEBODY focuses on body proportions, wheel fitment, and ride height.

subtitle.zh: 街道与赛道之间的平衡

lede.zh: 围绕制动、底盘反馈与持续驾驶需求，整理更明确的性能升级方向。
lede.en: Braking, chassis feedback, and repeatable performance define a clearer road-and-track setup.

story.zh: 设定并不追求一组固定答案。车辆反馈、轮胎状态和实际道路会不断改变下一步调整。
story.en: There is no fixed answer. Vehicle feedback, tire condition, and real-world testing continue to shape each adjustment.

body.en: Sharper response without turning the car into a single-purpose machine. Braking, chassis feedback, and wheel fitment are considered as one system.
body.zh: 提升响应，同时保留车辆在真实道路中的完整性。刹车、底盘反馈与轮毂数据作为一个系统共同调整。

alt.zh: 分类参考图片：刹车系统

body.en: Each change is judged through real driving, tire condition, and driver feedback. The setup evolves until the car responds as one complete package.
body.zh: 每一次变化都通过真实驾驶、轮胎状态与驾驶反馈判断。持续调整，直到整车形成统一响应。

alt.zh: 分类参考图片：底盘设定
分类参考图片：锻造轮毂

description.en: LONMA DYNAMIC Case 02 ROAD & TRACK SETUP focuses on braking, chassis feedback, and repeatable performance.

subtitle.en: PROPORTION, RIDE HEIGHT, AND WHEEL FITMENT

lede.zh: 通过车高、轮毂数据与车身间隙，建立低而完整的侧面比例。
lede.en: Ride height, wheel fitment, and body clearance create a low, cohesive side profile.

story.zh: 低姿态仍然需要真实使用。每一次降低和数据变化，都要重新检查转向、通过性与视觉平衡。
story.en: A low stance still has to work. Every change to ride height or fitment is checked for steering clearance, road usability, and visual balance.

description.en: LONMA DYNAMIC Case 03 LOW STANCE focuses on ride height, wheel fitment, and body clearance.

lede.zh: 结合车辆状态、数据记录与道路反馈，规划阶段性的动力响应升级。
lede.en: Staged calibration developed through vehicle health checks, data logging, and road testing.

story.zh: 程序不是一次写入后的结束。记录、复查与道路反馈共同决定下一次修正。
story.en: A calibration is not finished after one flash. Data logging, review, and road feedback determine each revision.

description.en: LONMA DYNAMIC Case 04 TURBO TUNING focuses on staged calibration, data logging, and road testing.

subtitle.zh: 车辆状态转化为视觉内容
subtitle.en: TURNING VEHICLE CHARACTER INTO VISUAL CONTENT

lede.zh: 以静态、Rolling Shot 与短视频记录车辆完成后的姿态和细节。
lede.en: Still photography, rolling shots, and short films capture the finished car's stance and details.

story.zh: 影像不是改装结束后的附加项。拍摄角度、场地和运动方式会重新解释车辆的比例与性格。
story.en: Automotive media is not an afterthought. Camera angle, location, and motion reveal the car's proportions and character.

description.en: LONMA DYNAMIC Case 05 AUTOMOTIVE MEDIA FEATURE focuses on still photography, rolling shots, and short films.

subtitle.en: ONE DIRECTION FOR PERFORMANCE AND DESIGN

lede.zh: 让外观、底盘与动力响应围绕同一驾驶目标协同调整。
lede.en: Exterior, chassis, and power delivery are developed around one driving objective.

story.zh: 完整项目不是零件数量的叠加。先确定目标，再通过多次测试保留真正改善车辆的变化。
story.en: A complete build is more than a parts list. The goal comes first, followed by repeated testing that keeps only the changes that improve the car.

description.en: LONMA DYNAMIC Case 06 BLUE PERFORMANCE BUILD focuses on exterior, chassis, and power delivery.
